text:
maria: Hey folks — opened a PR that touches /infra/config/ and /runtime/serve/. CODEOWNERS points to @infra-team which looks like an alias with no active members. Need an approver or proxy so we can unfreeze staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123

jon: can you paste which CODEOWNERS entries are affected?

maria: sure — here's the snippet:

maria: ```
/infra/config/ @infra-team
/runtime/serve/ @runtime-maintainers
```

tara: I can review the infra config, but I'm not in the @infra-team alias so I can't formally approve from that group.

ben: I can proxy-approve for small config churn, but runtime touches probably need a runtime owner signoff.

leo: oncall — if this is blocking staging and CI is green I can merge after approvals. cc maria

merge-bot: ci/pipeline #4123: all checks passed ✅

jon: runtime-maintainers — who is the active person for /runtime/serve/ right now?

maria: last mapping was to @runtime-maintainers -> tara and ash. ash is OOO this week.

tara: correct, ash is out. ben + me would be two humans; would that satisfy the CODEOWNERS requirement or do we need the alias?

ben: proxy from a senior eng-platform lead is usually fine for small rollups. I'm happy to proxy if I review the runtime change quick.

jon: can do a quick sanity review in ~30m.

leo: plan then: jon does quick check, ben proxy-approves, I merge if CI stays green. Sounds ok?

maria: thank you — that would unstick staging. tagging @eng-platform for visibility 👋

ben: :thumbsup:

merge-bot: merge-bot: merge queue updated — awaiting manual merge by leo.
